Ukraine Peace Plan Discussed in Miami with US Envoys

Ukrainian negotiators traveled to Miami, United States, to discuss a new peace plan aimed at resolving the ongoing conflict with Russia. Sources indicated that the plan is comprehensive and intended to break the current impasse. The discussions involved Trump envoys and European officials.
